package_check_discovery.reason: The exact built-tarball check exposed an undocumented deprecated medoid formal, an installed-package test that assumed repository-only historical evidence, a Sinkhorn test iteration budget below the package's fail-closed numerical requirement, and a vignette theme call that required albersdown 2.0 without declaring or gating that version. The default build also generated files outside the certified closed-world projection. No final certification record was collected.
package_check_discovery.vignette_policy: The exact-tarball pkgdown receipt is the collectible executable-documentation gate. The closed-world tarball is built without generated vignette outputs and R CMD check uses --ignore-vignettes on that exact tarball.

source_change.reason: The only R-tree change is a roxygen parameter declaration for the already-existing deprecated medoid formal; no executable R expression, C++ source, estimator, mapper, arm, seed, tolerance, or gate changed. The generated Rd topic now documents the formal. Test-only changes make repository evidence explicitly source-tree-only, keep non-oracle Sinkhorn contracts independent of T4transport, and raise one mapper regression's max_iter from 500 to 5000 so it satisfies the existing tolerance. Vignettes version-gate albersdown 2.0 styling and fall back safely on older allowed versions.

successor.protocol_change: Candidate source binding, v7-to-v8 output-directory label, and explicit closed-world check policy only.
